rule: Issued intact units retain source ownership, home-unit identity, unit standards and history. Command assignment changes authority only. Raw personnel assignments retain source accounting/home claims and may remain unorganized until lawfully formed into homogeneous units.
return_rule: Restore surviving people/units to their source home chain; preserve casualties, injuries, experience, morale/cohesion, lawful promotions, equipment/mount losses and service history; dissolve receiving-only formations/orders; then run source-owner reconstitution from real resources.
